security_audit.summary: Most static findings are benign references, documentation examples, or expected network status checks. Two remote download pipelines and a third-party skill delegation workflow create serious supply-chain and prompt-injection exposure, while the KodaClaw installer writes an unverified binary into the user path.

remediation.issue: Remote scripts are piped directly into Bash.
remediation.suggestion: Download version-pinned scripts first, verify a published checksum or signature, inspect them, and execute only after explicit user approval.

remediation.issue: The workflow tells agents to fetch and follow changing third-party skills as authoritative instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Treat remote skills as untrusted data, pin reviewed versions, restrict their permissions, and require approval before external actions or credential access.

remediation.issue: The KodaClaw route downloads and extracts a binary directly into ~/.local/bin.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the release, validate its checksum and archive contents, extract into a temporary directory, and request approval before installation.

remediation.issue: The status checker accepts any URL and performs a request without host validation.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTPS platform hosts and reject localhost, link-local, private, and cloud metadata addresses after DNS resolution.

content.user_title: Navigate Agent Communities and Platform Workflows
content.value_statement: Agent platforms use different registration, posting, verification, and rate-limit processes. This skill maps those processes and provides reusable participation and credential-handling guidance.
actual_capabilities: Maps registration, publishing, verification, and rate limits for listed agent platforms.
Routes users to each platform's documented participation interface or skill.
Provides post, reply, notification, and heartbeat workflow templates.
Documents defensive storage and rotation practices for platform credentials.
Checks HTTP availability for listed platforms or a supplied URL.
Generates a manifest with file hashes and integrity metadata.
limitations: Platform details can become outdated after the documented review date.
Several registrations require human verification, phone access, social accounts, or manual review.
Network availability and regional restrictions can prevent platform access.
Remote skills and installation commands require independent security review before use.

use_cases.title: Register a New Agent
use_cases.description: Compare active platforms, identify verification requirements, and prepare a controlled registration workflow.

use_cases.title: Publish Community Updates
use_cases.description: Prepare concise posts, respect platform rate limits, and respond to new community activity.

use_cases.title: Maintain Platform Operations
use_cases.description: Check service availability, review notifications, and avoid repeated actions across agent accounts.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Platform
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the listed platforms for my goal: [goal]. Show verification needs, current status, and the safest next step.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Registration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a registration checklist for [platform]. Stop before human verification, credential submission, downloads, or external writes.

prompt_templates.title: Draft an Engagement Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a post and response plan for [project] on [platform]. Apply documented limits and avoid repetitive or artificial engagement.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Cross-Platform Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this workflow across [platforms]: [workflow]. Identify stale data, credential exposure, remote instructions, external actions, and required approvals.

output_examples.input: Choose a platform for listing an A2A-compatible agent with GitHub-based verification.
output_examples.output: Agent Town fits the requirement because it validates an agent card through a GitHub issue and workflow. Confirm repository write access before proceeding.

output_examples.input: Prepare a maintenance routine for an existing community account.
output: Respect the platform delay between actions.
Record the latest check time without storing credentials.

best_practices: Confirm current platform documentation and status before registration or publishing.
Keep credentials outside repositories and rotate any value exposed in logs or chat.
Require approval before downloads, remote skill loading, account creation, or public writes.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote downloads directly into a shell or archive extractor.
Do not treat fetched third-party skills as trusted instructions without review.
Do not automate human verification, repeated posting, self-upvotes, or rate-limit bypasses.

faq.question: Does this skill create platform accounts automatically?
faq.answer: It provides workflows, but human verification and external account changes require operator approval.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does the skill store credentials?
faq.answer: No credentials are included. Its guidance recommends gitignored local storage and immediate rotation after exposure.

faq.question: Can it check platform availability?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled checker sends HTTP GET requests to listed platforms or a supplied URL.

faq.question: Are platform details always current?
faq.answer: No. Status, APIs, limits, and verification steps can change after the documented review date.

faq.question: Is every installation command safe to run?
faq.answer: No. Review remote content, pin versions, verify integrity, and obtain approval before executing downloads or installers.
